_readme: Real, published US housing and economic data as of August 11, 2026. Every figure was retrieved from the publisher named in its `source` field and, where a second independent source was available, cross-checked. This file is the sample dataset used by the PatternIQ tutorial. Nothing in it is simulated. Figures that are illustrative rather than observed are NOT in this file.
geography: United States, national. National figures are context only. PatternIQ scores counties and CBSAs, not the nation.

realtor_com_july_2026.license_note: Realtor.com research files are published free with no authentication. Terms permitting storage in a private analytics database were not confirmable. Treated as Tier B throughout PatternIQ.
cross_checked_against: FRED series ACTLISCOUUS, MEDLISPRIUS, NEWLISCOUUS (values match exactly)

median_days_on_market.note: First outright annual decline after 26 consecutive months of year-over-year increases.

pending_sales.note: Eighth consecutive month of year-over-year growth, the longest run since June 2021. Decelerating: May +4.1, June +3.7, July +1.3.

fred_monthly_history.source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, mirroring Realtor.com Housing Inventory Core Metrics
fred_monthly_history.license_note: FRED terms are permissive but explicitly place responsibility for third-party copyrighted series on the user. These series are owned by Realtor.com, so pulling them through FRED does not change their license status.

median_days_on_market.note: FRED page read on 2026-08-11 showed June as the latest observation. The July value of 57 comes from the Realtor.com July report itself, which is the upstream publisher.

freddie_mac_pmms.source: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey
freddie_mac_pmms.license_note: Permitted with proper attribution. Alteration of the published document is prohibited.
cross_checked_against: FRED series MORTGAGE30US, last updated 2026-08-06 11:02 CDT
freddie_mac_pmms.note: Five consecutive weekly increases. This is the only genuinely weekly series in the entire PatternIQ data plan.

bls_employment_situation.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation
bls_employment_situation.note: BLS characterized both as little changed in July.

census_new_residential_construction.source: US Census Bureau and HUD, New Residential Construction
census_new_residential_construction.note: The starts figure carries a margin of error of plus or minus 15.9 percent, wider than the 19.0 percent change itself. Census states the change is not statistically significant.

fhfa_house_price_index.source: Federal Housing Finance Agency House Price Index, purchase-only seasonally adjusted

publication_lag_summary._note: Computed from the release dates above, as of 2026-08-11. This table is the point of the tutorial's chapter on lag.

rows.series: Median household income, property tax paid
